sources.entry: Itsycal - A tiny calendar for that lives in the Mac menu bar.

summary.one_liner: Itsycal is a tiny calendar that lives in the Mac menu bar and can show events alongside the macOS Calendar app.
summary.what_it_does: Itsycal is a compact calendar displayed in the Mac menu bar. Optionally, it shows your calendar events as a companion to the Mac Calendar app. You can create and delete events from it, but the README says you cannot edit them. The README is short and mostly describes the project's purpose; it does not list detailed features, screenshots, or setup steps beyond a note on signing configuration. The project's source code is published as an example of an app to learn from.
use_cases: see a calendar in the Mac menu bar
create or delete Mac calendar events quickly
companion view for the Mac Calendar app
how_to_run: Read CONTRIBUTING.md for build and signing setup
Copy Local.xcconfig.example to a local xcconfig file and configure signing
notable: Tiny footprint, lives entirely in the menu bar
Shows events from the macOS Calendar app
Source code published explicitly as a learning resource
caveats: Events can be created and deleted but not edited
Building requires a local xcconfig signing file described in CONTRIBUTING.md
keywords: show calendar events in menu bar
